svg.aria-label: Author (context): Publishes posts. Post service (in focus): Writes source posts. Post store (in focus): Source posts and timelines. Reader (in focus): Reads a page of posts. Feed service (in focus): Builds and filters pages. Filter and paginate the merge. Follow store (context): Follower relationships. Fan-out queue (in focus): Buffers follower updates. Feed store (in focus): Prepared feed references. Policy service (in focus): Checks current visibility. Flow: Post service to Fan-out queue: Queue ordinary post. Fan-out queue to Feed store: Save feed entries. Reader to Feed service: Read feed. Feed service to Feed store: Read prepared feeds. Feed service to Post store: Merge popular feeds. Feed service to Policy service: Check access.
